name: comp-145
title: Payment Card Checkbox
blurb: Card checkbox with payment card icon (Mastercard) and description.
description: Bordered card checkbox featuring a payment card logo icon (Mastercard SVG). Full card clickable via pseudo-element. Includes label, sublabel, and description.
use_when: Selecting payment methods in checkout or payment settings.
avoid_when: Non-payment selections—the card icon is payment-specific.
a11y: Checkbox properly labeled. Card icon is aria-hidden. Full keyboard navigation with focus states.
